spec.title: About this view

options.content:
Which safeguards have a result, and which of them pass?

Missing or partial evidence is Unknown. [Runbook](https://github.com/iT3E/tnwks-ops/blob/main/security/README.md)

spec.description: Purpose, scope and the interpretation of missing evidence.

spec.title: Safeguards in the registry
spec.description:
The lines of the control registry: 48 safeguards of CIS Controls v8.1. A count below that means that the rules of the registry do not run.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: With a result
spec.description:
Safeguards for which one system or more has a fresh result, a pass or a fail. For the others no check exists, or its source is late.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Passing
spec.description:
Safeguards for which each system that has a check passes. A safeguard with a result on one system and none on a second system is not in this count.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Failing
spec.description:
Safeguards for which one check or more fails on a system. The Systems tab says where.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: State of each safeguard
spec.description:
One line for each safeguard: Fail when a check fails on one system or more, Pass when each system that has a check for it passes, and No evidence when one of those systems has no fresh result. A result counts only while its source is inside its limit. A line never shows Pass for a check that did not run.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Failing safeguards by system
spec.description:
Each safeguard that fails, on the system where it fails. The security stream `findings` in Loki lists each failed finding.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Safeguards with a result

spec.expr: count by (system, system_type) (homelab:security_control_state{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"} > 0) or on (system, system_type) (0 * count by (system, system_type) (homelab:security_control_state{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"}))

spec.description:
For each system of the registry, the number of safeguards with a fresh result. A system at 0 has no source that reports.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Systems in the registry
spec.description:
Each system that the platform checks, from security/registry/systems.yaml. A new system is one line in that file.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Age of the last result
spec.description:
Time since the newest result of each source, for each system. A source is late after: Prowler 36h; Trivy Operator 36h; The host check 12h; The API checks 36h; The security streams 15m, k8s-audit 15m, routeros 15m, cloudtrail 2h; Wazuh 30m, laptop 7d. These limits are in security/registry/sources.yaml.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Late sources
spec.description:
Each source whose newest result is older than its limit, or that serves no time. The safeguards that rest on it show No evidence until it reports again.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Failing checks
spec.description:
The number of checks of each source that fail on each system.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Accepted findings
spec.description:
The lines of the encrypted list of accepted findings. The owner writes each line, with a reason and an end date. No value means that the list has no line, or that nothing serves it.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Past their end date

spec.expr: sum(max by (source, check, system) (homelab_security_accepted_until_timestamp_seconds{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"}) < bool time())

spec.description:
Accepted findings whose end date has passed. The owner renews each one or removes it.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Accepted findings by system
spec.description:
The number of accepted findings of each system.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.
